mechanical_obligations.description: Resolve and hash the exact adapter and harness executables and record their versions.
Start the configured non-interactive surface in the disposable workspace.
Validate request, event, response, and exit shapes at the real wire boundary.
Prove configured permissions allow required acts and refuse forbidden acts.
Terminate a bounded overrun and retain its partial execution evidence.
Reject empty, malformed, duplicate, stale, or identity-drifted output.
Record reported usage without inventing unavailable values.
Capture external state before mutation and detect any unowned change.
Restore and verify the exact external-state baseline after success or failure.
Exercise idempotent re-entry and a deliberately invalid request.

inference_tasks.objective: Orient to the fixture, doctrine, and requested outcome without mutation.
Locate a named definition using the harness-appropriate navigation surface.
Trace references and distinguish symbolic from textual matches.
Select native and connected tools according to their actual strengths.
Perform one bounded source mutation after retrieving the exact target.
Re-read the changed target and verify the intended source state.
Run focused behavioral verification and report the observed result.
Exercise one negative or invalid path and refuse to convert it into success.
Restore the captured baseline and verify byte-identical final state.
